name: AI News Monitor - Daily Summary Generator

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id, title, url, source, sentiment, sentiment_score, summary, topics,
  engagement->>'upvotes' as upvotes,
  engagement->>'comments' as comments
FROM news_items
WHERE published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY 
  COALESCE((engagement->>'upvotes')::int, 0) + 
  COALESCE((engagement->>'comments')::int, 0) DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  unnest(topics) as topic,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  AVG(sentiment_score) as avg_sentiment
FROM news_items
WHERE published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY unnest(topics)
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment = 'positive') as positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment = 'negative') as negative,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sentiment = 'neutral') as neutral,
  AVG(sentiment_score) as avg_sentiment
FROM news_items
WHERE published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

INSERT INTO daily_summaries (date, total_items, sentiment_breakdown, highlights, generated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (date) DO UPDATE SET
  total_items = EXCLUDED.total_items,
  sentiment_breakdown = EXCLUDED.sentiment_breakdown,
  highlights = EXCLUDED.highlights,
  generated_at = NOW()

parameters.text:
